notes: CHOSEN Checkpoint 2 validation structure. Binary (no TCR). Peptide chain C/F matches E01 (DQ2.5-glia-a1a) core PFPQPELPY exactly. Kim et al. 2004 PNAS.

Binary DQ8 validation candidate (doc previously mis-described this as non-gluten insulin B -- confirmed on RCSB 2026-09-21 it IS a DQ8+gluten complex). Peptide contains E09 (DQ8-glia-a1) core EGSFQPSQE exactly. Henderson et al. 2007 Immunity.

Ternary (TCR JR5.1). Out of scope for peptide-MHC modeling (see pdb_structures.md); kept for record. C-terminal PGS in the deposited peptide chain is a construct tag, not native gliadin. Petersen et al. 2014 NSMB.
Ternary (TCR d2). Same peptide/epitope as 4OZF, 2 copies in ASU. Out of scope for modeling.
Ternary (TCR s16). Same peptide/epitope as 4OZF. Out of scope for modeling.

Ternary (TCR s2). RCSB structure-summary text called this alpha2; the actual deposited peptide sequence matches E01 (glia-a1a) core PFPQPELPY exactly, not alpha2 -- verify epitope assignment from sequence, not from summary text, before citing. (Its own COMPND record independently confirms this: 'DEAMIDATED GLIADIN-ALPHA1 PEPTIDE'.) Not a modeling target, but USED 2026-10-05 as the second structure in the crystal-vs-crystal RMSD baseline (grains.superpose) since it carries the same E01 peptide as 1S9V from an independent deposition. CHAIN PAIRING TRAP: peptide chain J binds MHC A/B and chain I binds C/D -- the reverse of the lettering; see pdb_structures.md.
Ternary (TCR SP3.4). Same peptide as 2NNA. Out of scope for modeling. Broughton et al. 2012 Immunity.
